description: This file defines a static class 'Slug' with an extension method 'GenerateSlug' for creating URL-friendly slugs from input strings. It contains regex patterns used for sanitizing and formatting strings into slugs.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static utility class providing slug generation functionality for URL-friendly strings.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Extension method that converts an input string into a URL slug by removing invalid characters, collapsing spaces, trimming length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.

methods.name: InvalidCharsRegex
methods.description: Generated regex to match invalid characters for slug.

methods.name: MultipleSpacesRegex
methods.description: Generated regex to replace multiple whitespace characters with a single space.

methods.name: TrimRegex
methods.description: Generated regex to replace whitespace with hyphens.
